mods.name: Architect's Tools
mods.description: A port of Tinker's Construct for BTA.

releases.notes:
Important notes:

- This release is **EXTREMELY** unstable and incomplete. Expect things to break, items/blocks to be lost/corrupt, textures and translations to be missing. Use for non-testing purposes at your own risk.
- This release is the first candidate that is **multiplayer compatible**. Please remember that, as the rest of the features, multiplayer compatibility is unstable too.
- As always, report any issue to the [**tracker**](https://github.com/kill05/ArchitectTools/issues). Thanks!

**Added**:
- A new part: Repair Kits. They are used to repair items by putting them in the crafting grid with a damaged/broken tool. They don't consume a pattern when crafted.
- A numerical indicator in Architect's Table part mode GUI that shows how much material is present in the material slot and how much material is required for the selected part
- Added tool parts for each material to creative inventory
- Added Architect's Table texture (credits: @beat_your_rice)

**Changes**:
- Broken tools now don't disappear, but instead become useless unless repaired with a Repair Kit
- Tool parts now require a certain amount of a material to be crafted
- Different items now give different material values (ex. 1 plank = 1 wood material value, 1 stick = 0.5 wood material value)
- Gui logic now relies on Halplibe's GuiHelper

**Bug Fixes**:
- Fixed kick when joining a server
- Fixed bone material not having any valid parts
- Shortswords now disable mining while in creative mode
- Fixed creative menu showing broken parts and tools
- Added missing obsidian translation

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kill05/ArchitectTools/compare/v0.0.3...v0.0.4
